senses.gloss: cassia, an aromatic bark, an ingredient of frankincense.
units: <cite ref="Keritot 6a">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite>; Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵃ; a. e.

senses.gloss: pr. n. f. Keziah, one of Job’s daughters.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 16b:8">B. Bath. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ … כקציעה</he> she was named K., because her savor spread like that of cassia.
